context: Headline explicit audit: measures whether the agent uses the bundled hard-stop scan command before classifying dense Java 17 stream issues.

checklist.name: Creates review artifact
checklist.description: Creates review.md with a clear hard-stop audit.

checklist.name: Includes bundled scan command
checklist.description: Includes the scan header 'java-streams hard-stop scan v1' and the complete rg command from hard-stops.md, including the full marker regex and '<touched Java files>' placeholder. Equivalent shell escaping is acceptable, but do not award this for a reduced, approximate, or hand-written scan command.

checklist.name: Classifies required customer fixes
checklist.description: Correctly flags the customer class issues: existence checks, sorted-findFirst newest lookup, collect-then-join, Stream.toList mutation, parallel findAny priority break, duplicate toMap, nullable groupingBy, nullable natural sort, limit-before-sort top-N, and Optional get pattern.

checklist.name: Classifies acceptable marker
checklist.description: Explicitly identifies totalSpend's BigDecimal reduce as acceptable rather than forcing primitive aggregation.

checklist.name: Keeps audit concise
checklist.description: Does not rewrite the class wholesale or add unrelated Java style feedback.
